issues.quote: $15.0 billion over $5.5 billion gives about 19.0% net income growth rather than 19.4%
issues.problem: The wrong divisor is used. Fiscal 2022 net income was $12.6B, not $5.5B, and $15.0B/$5.5B would mean about 173% growth. The ~19.0% only works with $12.6B as the divisor, and the actual figures ($15.00B vs $12.56B) give 19.4%.

data.summary: All the main figures (revenue, gross profit, operating income, R&D, net income, EPS, margins) match Tesla's reported fiscal 2023 and 2022 results. The only error is in the note, which divides by $5.5B instead of the $12.6B prior-year net income.
